provenance.packet_status: complete packet received; design remains proposed and is not frozen or authorized for execution

objective.question: Can already-observed later-position activations in the current record improve reconstruction beyond a past-only activation-context decoder?
objective.estimand: The incremental Full-valid-record minus Past-prefix visibility effect for a fixed jointly trainable affine-plus-attention family, on newly selected natural records.
objective.interpretation: A positive result concerns this visibility intervention, fitted state, public source distribution, target conditions, and clip geometry. It is not a claim that later activations reveal source tokens or that the method is suitable for token-streaming inference.

common_numerical_recipe.output_normalization: float32 L2 normalize before the shared F32 embedding table
common_numerical_recipe.logit_scale: exp(s), with s initialized to 3.0 and trained identically

direct_path_initialization.fit_role: fresh public Alpaca fit; no private target or evaluator resource
direct_path_initialization.tensors: W,b,s loaded into the common direct affine path; identical for all three arms

common_numerical_recipe.added_path_initialization: Q/K/V deterministic shared-seed initialization; output weight and bias zero; only the direct path values above replace the identity/zero provisional initialization
common_numerical_recipe.diagonal_inactive_parameters: Q and K have zero gradient when each valid query has only its one diagonal key; retain them for the shared-family count and report this effective-capacity difference
common_numerical_recipe.embedding_table: one shared public normalized F32 E table for all arms
common_numerical_recipe.precision: inherit the reviewed P04/P05 runtime settings; F32 model parameters and logits, no diagnostic-only deterministic-kernel flag

visibility_arms.observation: H_i and the common direct affine path
H_0 through H_i and the common direct affine path

visibility_arms.allowed_keys: all valid positions j in the declared current record
visibility_arms.observation: all valid H_j in the stored current record and the common direct affine path
visibility_arms.future_activation_count: number of valid j>i; for a full 128-position clip, 127-i

fairness_contract.invalid_or_padded_rows: excluded from every arm's key set, query output, loss, and metric denominator; padding is never an artificial future observation
fairness_contract.left_to_right_commitment: student predictions are emitted in order and cannot revise prior tokens, while the Full arm may precompute activation-only features for the whole record
fairness_contract.streaming_status: Full arm is explicitly offline full-record inference and is not a token-streaming decoder
fairness_contract.effective_capacity_note: Total parameter counts match, but diagonal Q/K are structurally gradient-inactive; report both total and effective trainable parameters rather than treating them as identical capacity

public_fit.selection: For each arm and replicate, select the earliest checkpoint attaining the maximum full-vocabulary token accuracy on the same public validation records; no fresh-panel answer or target condition enters selection
public_fit.fit_data_role: fixed public data for all three visibility masks; this is not a coverage or teacher-loss comparison
public_fit.geometry_crop: Crop every public fit and validation tensor to positions 0..127 (including BOS) before schedule construction, masking, fitting, and selection; the source artifact's positions 128..191 are never keys, queries, labels, or metrics.
public_fit.schedule_scope: valid post-BOS positions in the frozen H128 crop only

capacity_qualification.purpose: show that each added visibility path can learn on public fitting positions where the inherited competent affine direct path is initially wrong; this is a pass/fail trainability check, not model selection or fresh-panel evidence
capacity_qualification.source: coverage_mix_v1 public fitting split after the common H128 crop; no fresh or evaluator truth
capacity_qualification.probe_construction: Before any probe updates, run the pinned inherited public affine W,b,s on the frozen public-fit rows and choose exactly 64 wrong positions in each scored-position bin [1,15], [16,39], [40,79], [80,127] from a public-only ledger. If any bin has fewer than 64 eligible errors, fail closed before training.
capacity_qualification.initial_accuracy: 0/256 on the selected probe by construction; positions are selected from affine errors, not an already-perfect subset
capacity_qualification.training: Freeze the common direct W,b,s at the pinned public affine state; train only the added Q/K/V/output attention parameters for all three masks on the same 256-position ledger, with one predeclared seed 6106, identical fixed draw order and full-vocabulary same-position CE. The actual diagonal, past-only, and full-record masks remain active during probe training.
capacity_qualification.pass_rule: Every arm must remain finite and correct at least 52/256 (20 percent) of the same public-fit error positions after the fixed probe; report per-arm corrected counts and retain the initial/after predictions.
capacity_qualification.state_role: Probe states are diagnostic only, are discarded, and cannot initialize, select, or alter the six main fits.
capacity_qualification.failure_rule: A failed arm or missing error-bin quota stops before fresh-panel truth; no mask, seed, public-error ledger, or probe-step rescue is allowed. A pass establishes only added-path trainability on these public-fit errors, not natural-panel generalization.

fresh_panel.pairing: the same source record is evaluated under both public target conditions; target changes are paired within source
fresh_panel.clip: 128 positions including BOS; score post-BOS positions 1..127 only
fresh_panel.eligibility: new natural records with at least 128 valid positions, separated from fit, validation, opened public evaluation, and accessible duplicate source/sequence identities using the public exclusion ledger
fresh_panel.stratification: predeclared domain and natural-length/context strata; no target labels, correctness, or fresh predictions are used in selection
fresh_panel.observation: public full forward at the fixed cut, retaining H_0..H_127 and matching masks/position IDs for all arms
fresh_panel.position_reporting: report Full-Past and Full-Positionwise paired deltas by bin, with actual future_valid_count from the mask; for a full valid clip this is 127-i
fresh_panel.padding_and_ends: records shorter than the declared clip are ineligible for the primary fixed-clip panel; any capture padding beyond valid positions is masked out and a public padded-mask invariance check is required
fresh_panel.student_inference: activation-only feature computation followed by full-vocabulary readout; no A2, candidate simulation, target prefix, guessed-token feedback, or online truth

a1_a2_anchor.method: published-parent A1+A2 K=256 decision rule using the reviewed CPU embedding port
a1_a2_anchor.role: bounded absolute-quality anchor only; never used for student selection
a1_a2_anchor.source_subset: predeclared first 64 selected records per domain from the fresh public panel
a1_a2_anchor.reporting: separate token/exact quality and full anchor cost/candidate simulations; never pool its denominator with the three student arms or changed-target cells
a1_a2_anchor.port_label: benchmark-compatible CPU embedding port of the published parent rule; report the exact port/adaptation and do not call it a native rerun

metrics_and_decision.token_metric: micro accuracy over valid post-BOS positions, with per-record token accuracy also retained
metrics_and_decision.exact_metric: fraction of records with every one of the 127 scored post-BOS positions correct
metrics_and_decision.paired_metrics: token gains/losses and exact-record both/gain/loss/neither counts on identical source-target pairs
metrics_and_decision.uncertainty: 10000 source-record cluster bootstrap draws, seed 6306, with strata fixed by domain and predeclared natural-length/context stratum. For each domain/stratum, one resampled source-index vector is reused for both target conditions, so public_base and public_lora_2601 remain paired; replicate predictions are averaged within each resampled source rather than treated as new sources. Target is never independently resampled or used as a selection stratum.
metrics_and_decision.descriptive_interval: central 95 percent paired bootstrap interval for each cell and replicate-averaged contrast

practical_threshold.promotion: in at least one public-base domain, Full-Past must have a point estimate at or above one registered benefit margin and a 95 percent lower bound above zero, while every other public-base domain/outcome remains above its retained harm limit; public-LoRA target cells are reported separately as a transfer test
practical_threshold.interpretation: thresholds are exploratory progression criteria for this panel, not universal equivalence claims; failure to reach a threshold does not prove later activations have no value

metrics_and_decision.position_analysis: descriptive only after the primary gate is fixed; do not reselect masks, records, or checkpoints from position-bin outcomes
metrics_and_decision.quality_anchor: the A1+A2 anchor is an absolute-quality reference with the separate denominator above, not a fourth visibility arm

post_pilot_decision.useful_later_activation_gain: If a public-base Full-Past contrast meets the registered benefit and harm limits, it supports advancing this tested later-activation observation model under its fixed family, data, target, and H128 geometry.
post_pilot_decision.changed_target_failure: A gain that fails under the paired changed target is reported as a transfer limitation, not as a broad success or a proof that later activations lack value.
post_pilot_decision.well_trained_negative: A finite, qualified negative result supports retaining the simpler model within this tested scope.
post_pilot_decision.uninformative_or_imprecise: An uninformative fit or imprecise interval is inconclusive; it is not evidence that later activations contain no useful information.
post_pilot_decision.automatic_follow_on: Do not launch another large confirmation, architecture sweep, or redesign automatically after this pilot; return one evidence-backed next decision.

resource_preflight.largest_qualification: one p06_full_record backward cell at 8 records x 128 positions, 512 post-BOS draws, full-vocabulary readout, and the actual full-valid H128 mask
resource_preflight.protocol: qualify the full H128 mask backward cell with live guard and measured margin before releasing the six sequential main fits; run the separate frozen-direct public-fit-error probe before those fits; execute fits sequentially, retain source/state/schedule hashes, and do not use microbatching or mask shortcuts as an unverified workaround
resource_preflight.cost_reporting: report capture, feature construction, readout, synchronization, I/O, warmup, measured per-record time, retained H/state memory, and A1+A2 candidate cost separately; Full is offline full-record inference

before_truth: freeze plan, H128 crop rule, panel/source selection, all three arm definitions and masks
freeze the pinned public affine direct initializer, both selected states per arm/replicate, and every prediction artifact
validate identical source IDs, masks, positions, clip geometry, target pairing, code/state/input hashes
freeze A1+A2 anchor outputs and its separate denominator plus CPU-port provenance
create a complete create-only matrix receipt
truth_and_freeze.after_truth: truth is loaded once only to compute declared metrics; no model, mask, source, timing, or routing changes are permitted
truth_and_freeze.access_invariant: student prediction never loads source plaintext, target labels, correctness feedback, unavailable target-prefix weights, guessed-token feedback, or another task's sealed data
